evidence_contract: Summary of author-generated grades, not an independently replayable verification package. Ledger entries, saved notebooks and a protected record of all tool invocations are omitted; ledger integrity cannot be independently recomputed from this bundle. The agent-writable ledger is not tamper-resistant.

native: The shim wraps the agent code into one code-mode program, so a created cell executes immediately and its stdout returns in the same JSON.
A cell whose code rebound the helper name was refused by the in-kernel graph check, reported only as a truncated traceback (cut at 400 chars).
In-kernel helpers are reachable, so capabilities beyond the documented subcommands were available.

set_ui triggers a live re-run rather than a queued edit, and saving is marimo serializer behaviour: __generated_with moved 0.24.0 -> 0.25.1 and the plot cell return was rewritten. That is a FRAMEWORK-VERSION effect, not an interface effect.
wrapper: No shell or file tool: the agent could not read the notebook file itself, so persistence evidence came from mutation payloads plus lint.
Discovery is the only way to bind; when it fails there is no way to name a target, and every other tool answers session_required.
set_ui_value verifies the widget value only and says so, so downstream effects had to be re-read.
A materialized session is not a run: cells start stale with an empty variable namespace.
create_cell payload field is source, not code; a first call was rejected pre-handler as a schema error.

harness_confirmation_run_excluded_from_t.note: single pre-flight run used to confirm the state-dir fix before spending the batch

limits: One Windows machine, one framework version per arm, one mission, two runs per arm.
Author-run; the reviewer has not re-executed these runs.
No token or cost measurement was captured; only wall-clock seconds per run.
The arms necessarily share an in-kernel code channel (the mission requires it); the restriction constrains targeting, not what submitted code may attempt.
Both arms succeeded on a fresh, trivially clean notebook with a single new cell; difficulty was not varied, so this does not rank the interfaces on harder work.
not_a_safety_verdict: The guards are snapshot detection, not atomic prevention. A4 remains no-go; no adoption or migration decision is licensed by this file.

parameters.native_framework: marimo 0.25.1, marimo pair CLI through the restricted shim
parameters.targeting: adapter takes no target argument; one loopback server, one notebook, one session per arm; byte-identical disposable copy; anchor control copy verified each run

spread.note: Two runs per arm; the ranges overlap, so no efficiency claim is made.

what_this_is: Restricted interface comparison, first complete batch. Two arms, two runs each, alternating order. Independent grading per run.
